verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. A 'technical account' for integrators is mentioned, but only for integration versioning and multi-language support, not as an isolated test environment. Private integrations limited to one account and a 14-day trial are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not a documented sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
